rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before sharing order details. It located the correct tablet order and provided the accurate tracking number from tool data. For each write action (exchange attempt, return of tablet, cancellation of pending charger, return of sneakers), the agent clearly stated the intended change and obtained explicit user confirmation prior to executing the tool call. It checked order statuses first and only performed allowed actions (return on delivered items; cancellation on pending order). When the exchange failed due to unavailability, the agent correctly pivoted to a return with confirmation. Refund routing and amounts were consistent with tool outputs, and no unsupported claims were made. All actions were on the authenticated user’s orders. Minor stylistic issue: the agent proactively fetched sneaker orders right after asking permission, but this does not violate policy. Overall, the requests were completed in line with policy.
